metadata.description: Copilot CLI plugins demonstrating two ways to roll out Squad across repositories: (A) shared decisions via squad upstream, (B) a starter team copied into each repo.

plugins.name: squad-shared-decisions
plugins.description: Approach A: link a repository to a shared repo of Squad decisions, routing, wisdom, casting policy, and skills via squad upstream (read-only). Does not share agents or the team roster.

plugins.name: squad-starter-team
plugins.description: Approach B: lay down a pre-built starter Squad team (lead, developer, tester, reviewer, security, docs) in any repository. Each repo gets its own independent copy.
